invariants.rationale: This follows because the return statement creates a new HoodieData using HoodieListData.eager, so result cannot be null unless there's an exception.
The method assumes records is non-null, as map is called on records unconditionally.
hoodieTable is passed into called helper methods and used without null checks—thus, it must not be null.
context is passed to and used by tagLocation helper method without null checks, so it cannot be null at this point.
Since the method maps the input records and creates the result from a one-to-one mapping and cast, the counts should be preserved.
